decision.action: reject and completely remove producer signaling, any-order D9 wrapper, runtime route, harness option, and tests
decision.reason: The normally ordered D9 starts only about 8 us after selected down. A resident spinning D9 consumer competes with the critical selected-down producer for more time than the eliminated queue boundary costs; reducing atomic pressure to one leader per 16 lanes makes the complete decode regression larger.
